sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their impressive run. Sandbach are unbeaten in their last five matches (four wins and a draw) and sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games. They face a struggling Alsager Town side who occupy bottom place with just 4 points and have lost their last four consecutive matches, making this a fixture where the home side will be heavy favourites.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a match with title-race implications, with Stafford on 20 points looking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a battle between third and fifth place, both teams in strong form with recent wins. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in a mid-table encounter, while Bilston Town visit Foley Meir in a clash of sides separated by just one league position. Shawbury United host Barnton, with the visitors in better recent form despite both sides occupying lower positions. Market Drayton Town face New Mills in a fixture between two inconsistent mid-table teams. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a bottom-half struggle, while Brereton Social host Widnes Town — Widnes remain pointless after seven matches and are the division's poorest performers. Crewe face a trip to Allscott Heath in another lower-table affair.
